metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.6 · 1983 · Psycho II
metas.description: After twenty-two years of psychiatric care, Norman Bates attempts to return to a life of solitude, but the specters of his crimes - and his mother - continue to haunt him.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.5 · 1986 · Psycho III
metas.description: Norman Bates falls in love with a fallen nun who stays at the Bates Motel alongside a drifter and a curious reporter. Meanwhile, "Mother" is still watching.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 3.8 · 1987 · Bates Motel
metas.description: Alex West, who roomed with the late Norman Bates at the state lunatic asylum, inherits the infamous Bates Motel after Norman Bates dies, and tries to fix it up to make it a respectable business. But soon, strange events occur.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.4 · 1990 · Psycho IV: The Beginning
metas.description: Norman Bates recalls his childhood with his abusive mother while fearing his unborn child will inherit his split personality disorder.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 4.6 · 1998 · Psycho
metas.description: In Gus Van Sant's remake of Alfred Hitchcock's classic, young female bank employee Marion Crane steals money from her boss in Phoenix, flees town, and arrives at Fairvale, California's rundown Bates Motel, which has secrets of its...
